title: AI Revolutionizes Accessibility Testing
full_monologue: **AI made accessibility testing 10x faster overnight.** Imagine scanning an entire website in seconds, not hours. AI tools now automatically detect contrast issues, screen reader compatibility, and navigation errors—without needing a human to manually test each element. It’s like having a 24/7 accessibility expert on your team. And the best part? It scales effortlessly. No more endless QA cycles. Just instant feedback. What’s your biggest challenge in testing? Let me know below.
